views.label: The agent asks

views.label: The answer resumes work
views.note: answerInbox records the answer and starts a new container on the same conversation and workspace.

cards.title: Waiting costs nothing
items: The session goes waiting, or blocked for an approval
Its container is destroyed while it waits
The conversation id and the workspace are kept

cards.title: Reaching the phone
items: HTTPS through Caddy, or no service worker
On iOS the app must be added to the home screen
Discord is a second channel, never required

cards.title: One answer, any screen
items: Phone, desktop or Discord all call answerInbox
The first answer wins, the question closes
A failed resume gives the question back
